plain: A pair of attention parts in a transformer that spots "A then B" earlier in the text and, on seeing A again, predicts B.
eli5: Remembering that after "Twinkle twinkle" comes "little star", and saying it the next time you hear "Twinkle twinkle".
technical: A two-head attention circuit (a previous-token head composed with a copying head) that completes the pattern [A][B] … [A] → [B]; Olsson et al. (2022) tie its formation to the onset of in-context learning.
